title: daphne stenophylla
intro: Daphne stenophylla, commonly known as Stenandra, is a plant species belonging to the Thymelaeaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Daphne stenophylla include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, while its bioactive constituents include daphnetin and daphnodorin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential applications.
